candidates.label: 決算・経営説明会 説明資料 (2026-05-27, FY ending 2026-03 results)
candidates.matched_sentence: 金利上昇に伴う解約リスクの増加を、市場リスク削減による効果で一部相殺したことに加え、国内株式の上昇等の市場変動や新契約価値の獲得、期待収益の認識などにより適格資本が大幅に増加した結果、グループESRは前期末比+10%pt改善し220%

basis_evidence.quote: (1) 本資料内においては、内部モデルを用いて算出したESRについて、「ESR」と呼称しています。(2) ESRは、経済価値ベースの所要資本に対する経済価値ベースの適格資本の割合を示す指標です。ESRはマネジメントの判断に供することを目的として経済価値ベースの新たなソルベンシー規制(J-ICS)等を参考に算出しています。
basis_evidence.note: footnote on the section 目次 (table of contents) page, applies to every ESR figure in this deck including the p3/p4 220% headline. This is the single clearest basis statement of all 8 candidates -- it defines the document-wide meaning of the word 'ESR' as internal-model-based, in one sentence.

scope_evidence.quote: p3 slide title area: '26/3末 資本充足率(ESR) 220% (前期末比+10%pt)' inside a slide block headed 'グループESR'. p4 slide title: 'グループESR' with body text '...グループESRは前期末比+10%pt改善し220%'.
scope_evidence.note: 'グループ' (Group) is literally part of the metric's label on both slides that carry the 220% figure -- not an inferred scope, a stated one.

qualifiers.note: p4 also shows a bridge chart with '25/3末 210%' (prior fiscal year-end, FY2024/03) as a comparison anchor for the +10pt walk -- this is a prior-period value, not a same-period qualified alternative, and scan_adjusted did not flag it (no qualifier token attaches to it and it is not the same as_of). p5 discusses a separate '規制モデルのESR' (regulatory-model ESR) only as an unquantified reference ('規制モデルのESRを参照しつつも'), no number given on this page, so it did not surface as a same-doc competing value.

candidates.matched_sentence: 当社は、財務健全性の確保に向けて、経済価値ベースの資本充足率（以下、ESRという。）について170％以上の確保を基本としており、2026年３月末の内部ESRは220％と十分な水準を確保しております。

scope_evidence.quote: '当社グループの財務内容及び業績に悪影響を及ぼす可能性があります' surrounds the 220% sentence (risk-factors section framed at 当社グループ = the Group throughout); p56 headline restates: '財務健全性を示す資本充足率（ＥＳＲ）（注）８は、2026年３月末時点で220％となりました' inside the グループ修正利益 (Group adjusted profit) results narrative.
scope_evidence.note: less literal than the kessan_setsumei candidate (no metric literally named 'グループESR'), but the surrounding paragraph is explicitly about consolidated/group results throughout p56.

qualifiers.note: TRAP CONFIRMED PRESENT AND CORRECTLY NOT PICKED: p178 executive-compensation KPI table lists 資本充足率(ESR) 227% for '(2024年3月期)' actual (=FY2023/03) and 210% for '(2025年3月期)' actual (=FY2024/03) -- both prior fiscal years, both correctly absent from scan_adjusted's alt list because neither fragment carries the target pct (220) nor is same as_of. p68 also carries the 170% target-floor sentence (policy statement, not an actual).

candidates.recommend_note: Fully qualifies as an alternate/backup source (statutory 有報, machine-verified, matches EDINET S100YC7A text exactly, basis+scope both present). Not chosen as primary only because the kessan_setsumei candidate states the internal-model basis and Group scope more literally and directly on the same page as the headline number, and 決算説明資料 is the source type the jp lane's domain doc names as 정본(primary) (docs/domains/claude-agent-jp.md §2).
